answer: Each newcomer quotes one ferrous scrap grade in one city as its oracle. The registry hands that newcomer a grade-city pair, and it posts an hourly price backed by three dealer receipts from that city's ridge of scrapyards. Each report states its delta from the last quote; a quote straying over 3% from its receipts slashes a $500 bond. Standing arrives only after 90 days of hourly reports, 2,160 of them, and a missed week voids the run. Scaling to ten thousand copies would demand 10,000 pairs, $5,000,000 of slashable bonds, and 21,600,000 backed reports; a bought quote covers no second pair.
